backend_contract.create: POST /api/employees-v2/management/employees: optional monthly_salary + salary_effective_date (YYYY-MM-DD), confirmation CREATE_EMPLOYEE_V2
backend_contract.add_or_change: PUT /api/employees-v2/management/employees/{employee_id}: expected_version, monthly_salary, salary_effective_date, salary_confirmation CHANGE_EMPLOYEE_V2_SALARY, optional salary_reason
backend_contract.scope: Owner only; tenant comes from authenticated owner; optional login account remains independent.
backend_contract.atomicity: Existing atomic_owner Mongo snapshot/majority transaction covers identity, contract, audit and response reads. No standalone or compensation-delete fallback. Existing write pause and owner serialization remain enforced.
backend_contract.storage: One mezan_employee_salary_contracts_v2 document per tenant/employee; salary_revisions retain prior amounts with inclusive effective_from/effective_to. Adjacent revisions meet at previous day/new day. Corrupt overlap/gap/duplicate histories fail closed.
backend_contract.dates: New salary starts cannot precede 2026-10-01 or hire date. Future revisions supported. Same-day replacement and insertion before latest revision fail closed. Posted/reversed financial records and covered payroll periods freeze affected dates. Opening balances cover dates before cutover. Unknown financial dates require adjustment.
backend_contract.audit: mezan_employee_events_v2 stores employee_id, before/after snapshots, previous/new amount and effective_from, effective_date, changed_at/by, optional reason. Audit failure aborts salary writes.
backend_contract.accrual: Calendar-month day divisor; hire/start/end, effective salary and unpaid ranges respected. MZ2 posting clamps to approved cutover and accrued_at, posts only the next cumulative increment, and leaves historical monthly events immutable.
backend_contract.settlement: Bank statement evidence remains required. No default advance netting. Overpayment creates separate salary-payment and advance-grant debit/credit legs in one atomic journal/event. Existing explicit advance recovery remains available.
backend_contract.ui: Employee Management create/edit salary and effective date, hire-date default for new employees, add/change action, missing/current contract state and revision history. Scheduled amount is not displayed as current. AccountingPayroll defaults advance recovery off.
